messages:
sarah-support: Heads-up — customer reported build failures after upgrading to our Go SDK v2 tag. CI error: `module declares its path 'github.com/redwood/inference-go/v2' but was required as 'github.com/redwood/inference-go'`

morgan-eng: Yep that's the import-path mismatch. v2 modules must be imported with the /v2 suffix if the module path in go.mod includes it.

raj-sre: Can we get their minimal repro + go env + go list -m all? Often GOPROXY or cached old tags cause confusing errors.

sarah-support: Asked for those. They replied: Go 1.20, go.mod has `require github.com/redwood/inference-go v2.1.0` but all imports are `github.com/redwood/inference-go` (no /v2). Reproduced locally: `go build` fails with that exact module path error.

morgan-eng: Short-term workaround for them is a replace directive in their go.mod: 

```
replace github.com/redwood/inference-go => github.com/redwood/inference-go/v2 v2.1.0
```

After that run `go clean -modcache` and `go mod tidy`. That should unblock CI without changing imports.

sarah-support: They don't want to change hundreds of imports right now. Will try the replace. Is that safe for CI/monorepos?

raj-sre: Replace is fine as a local workaround, but not a long-term fix. It can hide other mismatches. Recommend they pin GOPROXY and clear modcache in CI. Also confirm there are no other transitive deps pulling the non-/v2 path.

morgan-eng: Root cause: when v2.1.0 was published we updated module path in go.mod to `github.com/redwood/inference-go/v2` (as semver requires) but didn't emphasize the import path change in the release notes. We're going to cut a small patch and update docs.

lina-support: I'll draft a KB that explains the error, shows the replace snippet, and includes the `go clean -modcache` step and `go get github.com/redwood/inference-go@v2.1.0` as alternatives. Will post to internal support library + customer reply template.

morgan-eng: I'll tag a hotfix v2.1.1 with clearer release notes and add a short migration guide in README showing both the correct import (`github.com/redwood/inference-go/v2`) and the replace workaround. We can't change module path (needs /v2), so docs are the right move.

ci-bot: deploy:changelog created by morgan-eng -> https://github.com/redwood/inference-go/releases/tag/v2.1.1

sarah-support: Thanks — sending the KB to the customer now with the replace snippet. Will follow up once they validate. :thumbsup:
